items.action: Write the dedicated MirrorMaker 2 config mm2/mm2-catalog.properties in the workspace. The kafka->redpanda flow allows only the three catalog topics, with checkpoints and group sync off. The full content is in plan.md.

evidence.reference: IdentityReplicationPolicy keeps topic names unchanged, which the services require because they subscribe to literal names. It disables MM2 cycle detection, so the allow-lists must be disjoint and heartbeats off.
